title: Message envelope v1
description: The envelope of Kafka events and RabbitMQ commands: the JSON object in the message body.

MessageId.description: Message id: UUID v7 in lowercase, the id of the outbox row.

CreatedAt.description: Creation time of the outbox row in UTC, with milliseconds: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ.

ChangeId.description: Id of a change of the publisher: UUID v7, the same in all messages of one change.

Draft/Id~1.description: A name with / and ~, which a JSON pointer escapes as ~1 and ~0.

KeyVersion.description: Version of the state of the message key.
